daily-digest_menu_detail: A read-only summary from the sources you choose
inbox-triage_menu_detail: Prioritized recommendations without changing your Inbox
pr-review_menu_detail: Review findings and follow-ups without public actions
daily-digest_description: Turn new activity into one concise digest. Choose what Persona may read and when to prepare it.
inbox-triage_description: Review new items and get prioritized recommendations. Persona will not change your Inbox or reply to anyone.
pr-review_description: Review pull requests and earlier review activity, then collect findings and follow-up suggestions in a private report.
daily-digest_task: Prepare a daily digest from {source}, limited to this scope: {scope}.
inbox-triage_task: Review {source} for triage, limited to this scope: {scope}.
pr-review_task: Review pull requests and follow up on earlier review activity in {source}, limited to this scope: {scope}.
daily-digest_output: Compare with earlier runs in this task's conversation. Group decisions needed, upcoming deadlines, and FYI. Include source links, say what changed since the previous digest, and note anything you could not read. Do not invent updates.
inbox-triage_output: Return a prioritized list of recommended actions: Needs you, Follow up, or FYI, with a short reason and a link for each item. Group related threads and only cover changes since the previous run. Do not mark items read, move or archive them, change triage, or send replies.
pr-review_output: Prioritize PRs awaiting my review, my PRs with new comments or failing checks, and unresolved threads from the previous run. Summarize findings with file, line, or check evidence and PR links. Separate requested changes from nits. Draft suggested replies locally only; do not post reviews, comments, approvals, or merges.
source_checking: Checking whether {source} provides the required read-only tools…
source_unavailable: {source} does not currently expose the read-only tools this template needs. Connect or enable it, or use {fallback}.
scope_daily_persona: Activity since the previous digest, prioritizing decisions and deadlines
scope_daily_external: New or changed items since the previous digest that need my attention
scope_inbox: Open items that need my attention, grouping related threads
scope_inbox_mail: Unread messages in all configured mailboxes
scope_pr_conversation: PR links, diffs, and review notes already in this routine's conversation
error_source: Choose a source this template supports.
error_scope: Describe what the routine should include.
error_scope_long: Keep the scope to 500 characters or fewer.
access_persona: Use only existing Persona Inbox items, to-dos, and schedule context available through read-only Persona tools. Do not create, complete, reschedule, or dismiss work.
access_inbox: Use only existing Persona Inbox items available through read-only Inbox tools. If those tools are unavailable, say so and stop.
access_conversation: Use only PR links, diffs, review notes, and earlier results already present in this task's conversation. No live GitHub access is configured; say when fresh repository data is unavailable instead of guessing.
access_connector: Use only these declared read-only source tools: {tools}. Do not use write actions, subscription changes, or a different tool to work around missing access.
read_only_safety: This is a read-only reporting routine. Never perform writes, outbound messages, public comments, merges, destructive actions, or changes to settings or schedules. If the required source or read-only tool is unavailable, explain that plainly and stop. Return a draft report only.
scope_hint: Describe the mailbox, query, people, or time window to include.
repository_hint: One repository as owner/name. The prompt will only read its PRs, reviews, diffs, and checks.
capability_check_failed: Persona could not check extension capabilities. Connector sources are unavailable, but built-in sources still work.
schedule_hint: You can adjust the full schedule again during review. The routine remains off until you turn it on.
advanced_note: Model, effort, computer, and working directory stay inherited from Assistant. On the review screen, open Advanced to set task-local overrides when the hub supports them. Raw model IDs stay inside Advanced.
safe_default: Starts off in Plan mode. Nothing runs or is created until you review the prompt and add the routine. Reports and reply suggestions are drafts only.
